meta.siteTitle: Lux3D · Turn one photo into a 3D model with real materials
meta.siteDescription: Lux3D is an AI-native 3D generation and creation platform. Upload an image or write a sentence to get 3D assets with real PBR materials — then edit, rig, animate, batch-generate and plug them into your workflow.

q1.q: What kind of 3D models can Lux3D generate?
q1.a: Most objects — characters, animals, props, furniture, buildings and artifacts. Output is a mesh with full PBR materials, or 3D Gaussians.

q2.q: Do I need to know 3D modeling?
q2.a: No. Upload an image or write a sentence. Pros can keep going in the editor with remeshing, retexturing and rigging.

q3.a: GLB, FBX, OBJ, USDZ, STL and more — ready for Blender, Unity, Unreal and 3D printing.

q4.q: Can I use generated models commercially?
q4.a: Models generated on paid plans can be used commercially, subject to the Terms of Service.

q5.q: How do I use the API?
q5.a: Create an API key in the developer console and use the Python / TypeScript / Java SDK or REST endpoints. Your first job runs in minutes.
